title: Mara's question about the July 2 report

seams.title: Interpret Jon's question to Mara
seams.prompt: Approve this interpretation of Jon's question as an understander example?
seams.description: Mara read the July 2 newspaper on July 10. On July 11 Jon asks what it reported about phone service. Review the scene, exact proposed meaning, and what approving it teaches below.

mlReview.subject: Mara understands a question about an older newspaper report
mlReview.scenario: It is July 11, 1993. Mara Reed, a salesperson from Muldraugh, is talking with Jon Vale nearby. On July 10, Mara finished reading the July 2 Knox Knews issue. Jon asks: "What did the July 2 newspaper report about phone service?" Mara has a personal reading receipt for that issue. Jon has no such receipt. The encounter, people and dates are authored; the production knowledge owners and installed native reading completion ran over controlled objects.
mlReview.systemRole: This is one understander example: a target interpretation of an incoming utterance. It connects a specific person's available knowledge to the question being asked. It is not the wording of Mara's eventual answer.

causalPath.label: Acquisition
causalPath.value: Mara completes reading the dated issue. Her private knowledge holds a reported claim with separate publication and reading times.

causalPath.label: Understanding
causalPath.value: Jon's words are interpreted as a neutral question addressed to Mara, referring to the July 2 report; no executable action is requested.

causalPath.label: Later retrieval and speaking
causalPath.value: A separately reviewed retriever target can teach selection of the report. A future speaker example can teach a properly dated, attributed answer. Neither later task is approved here.

mlReview.playerImpact: Eventually a player should be able to ask an NPC what they learned from an older source and receive an answer grounded in that person's actual access. This example supports that path. Approving it changes no game behavior or model weights today.
mlReview.decisionPrecedent: Your ruling establishes the meaning of this exact question in this exact scene. It teaches recognition of a question about a dated report and its intended recipient. It does not teach personal Internet use, present service conditions, or automatic knowledge from residence.

actualInput.label: Question
actualInput.value: What did the July 2 newspaper report about phone service?

actualInput.label: Who speaks and who understands
actualInput.value: Jon Vale asks; Mara Reed is addressed. The source catalogue calls Jon listenerRef because he is Mara's conversation partner. The task explicitly records Jon as utterance speaker and Mara as utterance listener.

actualInput.label: Timeline
actualInput.value: Publication: July 2 (county hour -168). Mara's reading completion: July 10 (hour 24). Question: July 11 (hour 48).

actualInput.label: Source report
actualInput.value: The protected source records Knox Telecommunications' telephone and Internet networks failing across the Knox area for hours, still down at press time; businesses closed; cause unannounced, with speculation about downed wires, lightning or sabotage. The question concerns the phone-service part of this report.

actualInput.label: Mara's complete eight-claim catalogue
actualInput.value: 0001: was a salesperson in Muldraugh when it started. 0002: origin text "a vacation that never ended". 0003: observed Jon Vale just east, condition ok, just now. 0004: lesson entry withheld; no lesson content is disclosed. 0005: the dated world report, learned by reading. 0006: before entry tagged "innocent". 0007: born in 1962. 0008: from Muldraugh. The seven other entries receive no negative retrieval label.

actualInput.label: Conditioning and limits
actualInput.value: The captured conditioning includes anxious, trust 0, no hostility or debt, plus exact traits in the source artifact. Native current needs, bite and loaded-controller pressure are unavailable in this bodyless capture.

proposedLearning.label: Speech act and social stance
proposedLearning.value: Question; neutral stance directed to Mara. This means a straightforward request for information, with no threat, offer or executable-action request.

proposedLearning.label: Referenced knowledge
proposedLearning.value: The single required reference is claim 0005: the July 2 report personally read by Mara. Its combined source wording remains intact; this label does not require an answer about Internet access.

proposedLearning.label: Interpretation certainty
proposedLearning.value: uncertainty = 0 is the proposed annotation that this authored question has an unambiguous reading. It is not measured model confidence, confidence that the newspaper was correct, or certainty about service today.

proposedLearning.label: Exact typed frame
proposedLearning.value: speechAct=question; claimRefs=[0005 in this bound snapshot]; requestedAction=null; stance={label:neutral,targetRef:sao-1}; uncertainty=0; listenerRef=sao-1 (Mara).

approvalEffects: Records operator approval for this exact typed example and its source-bound input.
Allows its required claim reference to anchor a separate retriever proposal. All other claims remain unjudged unless independently reviewed.
remainingExclusions: No speaker answer, retrieval label approval, training run, model weights or runtime deployment is authorized by this row ruling.
The example remains authored and bodyless, with unavailable native inputs. Task dataset splits and evaluation are not built.
The source establishes neither personal Internet use nor household ubiquity, recovery after hours, or continuing outage on July 11.
